items.title: Sam Dutrey Interview
items.q: And I didn't know that he had, well, they were friends until here of late, you know.

ctx.x: He taught me. And so we got into it. I didn't bring a lesson one day. And he and I had it. So I stopped going. And from then on, from then, I went on more.

Professor Mineta, you know, who played with you the other night, claims that he learned all he knows, mostly about clarinet from your father, that he was a wonderful teacher. And he's told us what a wonderful musician he was. Probably so.
And I didn't know that he had, well, they were friends until here of late, you know.
